scope: 10 distinct Wikimedia Commons file pages: two each for Serbia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, North Macedonia and Bulgaria.
method: Read each exact Commons file-description page and checked title, own-work statement, credited author and CC BY-SA 4.0 licence; checked filenames against the 19 existing changed photo registries in editorial PR #5 to avoid duplicates. Image pixels, source-chain authenticity and browser rendering remain unverified.
releaseRequirements: Before production: independently inspect actual image pixels and current Commons file history/rights, ensure the caption matches the depicted site, render visible author/file-page/licence links, indicate changes, honour share-alike for derivatives, verify offline behavior and do not claim a gateway pin lies at a landmark elsewhere.
